config.title: Settings

help.panel: Thickness of the panel wood. It sets the part sizes: the project inner volume is kept and the outer measures grow with the thickness.
help.proportion: Ratio between the box height, width and depth. Golden: 2.62 : 1.62 : 1. Louden: 1.9 : 1.4 : 1, keeps sides from being multiples of each other. Equal steps: 1.59 : 1.26 : 1. Cube: equal sides. Custom: you enter it. These are starting points, not a guarantee of better sound.
help.cutout: Driver hole in the front panel. The diameter comes from the datasheet; without it the cutout shows as "to be informed".
help.sheet: Enter the sheets you have, full sheets and offcuts (for example, 2.75 × 1.85 m and a 1.20 × 0.60 m offcut), to see how the pieces fit and how many sheets they use. An offcut is used only when it saves a full sheet. Thickness is the panel one.
help.dimensions: Inner: the volume the driver "sees". Outer: the finished box measures, with the wood thickness added.
help.totalsHelp: How much wood the project uses: area and cut length, with and without the MDF thickness.
help.partsHelp: Each piece with its final measures and cutouts. This is the list to take to the workshop.
help.volumeHelp: Checks that the net box volume in the plan matches the simulation; if it does not, the sound changes.
help.shape: Box height : width : depth. Pick a preset or edit the sizes. With "Keep the volume", Vb stays the same and the other sizes adjust; without it, Vb follows the box size.

config.lockVolume: Keep the volume (Vb) when changing sizes
config.lockVolumeOn: Changing one size adjusts the other two; Vb stays the same.
config.lockVolumeOff: Changing one size recalculates Vb; the other sizes stay. Fb is kept and the port adapts to it.
config.needsVolume: Enter the volume (Vb) to see the measures.
config.tooSmall: The outer size must exceed {{min}} (two panel thicknesses). The value was not applied.

parts.title: Parts and cutouts
parts.caption: Cut list for {{name}}

positions.portBoard: Diagonal in each corner, closing the triangular port (bevelled edges)

parts.convention: Assembly convention: front and back cover the whole face; top and bottom sit between front and back, at full width; the sides sit between top, bottom, front and back. No saw kerf, rabbets or joints.
parts.conventionDivider: The divider sits between the sides, top and bottom.

volume.title: Volume check
volume.caption: Volume per chamber, in {{unit}}
volume.matches: Matches the simulation: the plan's net volume is the one the simulation used.
volume.unavailable: Without the simulation's net volume, the plan can't be checked.

warnings.title: Plan warnings
warnings.cutoutTooBig: A cutout does not fit the short side of the {{piece}}: reduce the diameter or change the proportion.
warnings.cutoutsDoNotFit: The cutouts do not fit together in the {{piece}}: reduce the diameter, remove a driver or change the proportion.
warnings.cutoutTight: Little wood is left in the {{piece}}, less than the panel thickness ({{thickness}}): check that the part holds.
warnings.portLongerThanDepth: The port ({{length}}) is longer than the internal depth ({{depth}}): it will need a bend or fold.
warnings.driverCutoutUnknown: The driver cutout diameter ({{field}}) was not provided: the cutout shows as to be provided and positions change once it is.
warnings.portUnknown: The port has no dimensions: provide them to get its cutout and volume.
warnings.simulationUnavailable: Without the simulation there is no volume check or port length: complete the driver and the enclosure.
warnings.volumeMismatch: The plan's net volume differs from the simulation's. This should not happen: check the values and report the case.
warnings.portLongerThanDepth_rear: The rear port ({{length}}) is longer than the rear chamber depth ({{depth}}): it will need a bend or fold.
warnings.portLongerThanDepth_front: The front port ({{length}}) is longer than the front chamber depth ({{depth}}): it will need a bend or fold.
warnings.portUnknown_rear: The rear chamber port has no dimensions: provide them to get its cutout and volume.
warnings.portUnknown_front: The front chamber port has no dimensions: provide them to get its cutout and volume.
warnings.driverTooDeep: The loudspeaker is {{length}} deep behind the baffle and the chamber has only {{depth}} of internal depth: it does not fit, increase the depth or change the proportion.
warnings.cutoutOverlap: {{cutout}} on the {{piece}} touches another cutout or is closer to it than the panel thickness ({{thickness}}): move the cutouts apart.
warnings.cutoutInGlueBand: {{cutout}} on the {{piece}} is closer to the edge than the panel thickness ({{thickness}}), in the glue band: move it away from the edge.
warnings.cutoutOutside: {{cutout}} goes past the edge of the {{piece}}: move the cutout inside the panel.

drawings.title: 2D drawings
drawings.caption: Drawing of the {{name}} part: {{width}} by {{height}}
drawings.note: All parts share the same scale. The drawing's measures are in the parts table.
drawings.center: {{cutout}}: center {{x}} from the left and {{y}} from the bottom

view3d.title: 3D view
view3d.summary: Assembled {{type}} enclosure, {{width}} wide, {{height}} high and {{depth}} deep (external measures).
view3d.hint: Arrow keys rotate the box, + and − zoom, Home resets. You can also drag.

actions.unavailable: Available once the plan is complete: provide the missing parameters.

totals.title: Total cut
totals.hint: “Inner measures” uses the six faces by their inner measures, ignoring thickness. “Finished pieces” uses the plan pieces, thickness included. The difference is what the MDF adds.

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.empty: No piece fits the stock you entered.
sheets.unplacedWarning: Ran out of stock sheets for: {{pieces}}. Raise an item's quantity or add another sheet.
sheets.freeCut: Free-cut plan (CNC or router): some cuts stop inside the sheet and can't be made with a table saw alone.

stock.label: Available sheets
stock.limit: The stock takes up to {{max}} sheets.
stock.quantities: Quantity of each item (blank = no limit)

cut.label: Cut type
cut.help: Saw: every cut goes from edge to edge, as on a circular or panel saw. CNC/router: pieces nest freely and some cuts stop inside the sheet; needs a CNC or a router with a jig, but usually uses less sheet.

position.title: Position cutouts — {{piece}}
position.hint: Drag a cutout or use the arrow keys while it has focus (1 mm per press; 10 mm with Shift). Measurements go from the cutout center to the left and bottom edges, with the panel seen from the front.
position.resetDone: {{cutout}} is back to the automatic position.
position.resetAllDone: All cutouts of the panel are back to the automatic position.
position.announce: {{cutout}}: {{x}} from the left, {{y}} from the bottom.
position.noneMovable: This panel's cutouts have no size yet: enter them to position the cutouts.
position.unavailable: The plan is not ready: fill in the missing fields to position the cutouts.
position.autoHint: BuildBass picks the spot and follows box changes, without touching the fixed cutouts. Drag or type a measure to fix this cutout.
position.manualHint: You fixed this cutout: it stays here even if the box changes. Automatic ones move out of its way.
position.resetAll_one: Return the fixed cutout to automatic
position.resetAll_other: Return the {{count}} fixed cutouts to automatic
